title: Deliver pre-archive Outcome report on an independent PR
outOfScope: Merging or mutating the superseded combined draft PR #462 and its immutable archives.
Changing release, provider, identity, or security-sandbox behavior.
Weakening quality, coverage, archive, or review gates.

sources.reason: Defines the one Work Item/one branch/one PR lifecycle and closure requirements.
Current finish behavior archives automatically and must become active-Outcome-first.
End-to-end lifecycle regressions prove active preservation and explicit archive behavior.
Tracks the user requirement for direct, conversation-language reporting before archive.

rawUserRequest: Continue the authorized plan. Every Work Item must report directly in the current conversation language while it is active, before archive; then complete PR and branch cleanup. Process defects must be repaired before subsequent delivery.

declaredIntent.summary: Make direct, localized pre-archive Outcome reporting an enforceable default while preserving explicit archival and evidence integrity.

riskAssessment.reason: The finish/archival boundary governs the human decision point and installed adopter lifecycle.

executionDecision.reason: The user granted continuous authorization for planned remediation and its prerequisite process repairs.

preReviewWarnings: Do not treat stdout or an Outcome file as proof that the agent relayed the direct report; report delivery remains an agent responsibility.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Default ai-finish validates and writes a complete active Outcome but does not archive Contract, Summary, or Outcome; archival remains an explicit separate command.
ai-finish emits a clearly delimited, safe-to-relay direct report whose chrome follows English, Chinese, or Japanese conversation locale without inventing evidence prose.
Executable regressions cover active preservation, explicit archival, report ordering, structured risk/finding projection, localization chrome, and the adopter/core/journey lifecycle.
Plan, traceability, Capability Truth, and Japanese assessment are regenerated and aligned without altering immutable archived evidence.
guidelines: Preserve evidence integrity: do not claim generated stdout proves human-visible conversation delivery.
Make automatic archival impossible in the ordinary finish command and retain explicit archive validation.

intent.problem: Current main automatically archives a Work Item during ai-finish. That bypasses the required active-state human Outcome report and made RFE-103 invalid for the user-mandated report-before-archive boundary.
constraints: Default finish must preserve active Contract, Summary, and Outcome.
Archive must remain a separate explicit action.
Do not alter immutable prior archives.
Direct-report localization may not translate or invent arbitrary evidence prose.
Keep schema validation, redaction, evidence binding, and no-score restrictions.
intent.rationale: A durable human decision point must exist before archive; a structured evidence-derived report makes that boundary operational while explicit archival preserves audit integrity.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User authorized continuous remediation and process fixes, including governed workflow and policy artifacts.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Default finish produces a complete active Outcome and a localized direct-report payload without archive.
scenarioCoverage.reason: Protects the required human decision boundary.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Active Contract/Summary/Outcome remain until explicit archive succeeds.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run focused lifecycle, Outcome, localization, adopter, and full quality regressions.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Explicit archive after active Outcome produces archive evidence and no-active status.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Archive succeeds only through the separate explicit command.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
